name: Ink Bleed
description: Anisotropic capillary diffusion on paper: ink wicks along a procedural fibre grain roughly four times faster than across it, so blots elongate with the grain instead of spreading as isotropic discs. Fibre angle and wicking rate are modulated by the eight FFT bins, and the nib is a spring-damped pointer in extraBuffer[133..136] whose stroke speed thins the deposit. Renames a misleading binding-5 identifier (filteringSampler on the engine's NON-filtering sampler) and moves all float32 state reads to exact textureLoad.

updatedParams.name: Wicking Rate
updatedParams.description: Diffusion rate along the paper fibres; treble loosens the sizing.

updatedParams.name: Fade Speed
updatedParams.description: How quickly deposited ink dries out and fades.

updatedParams.description: Opacity mapping from ink concentration to alpha.
